title: Boring SaaS ideas for 30 September 2026
dek: Morning internet! Here's today's revenue notes on 10 products, 30 September 2026. 8 are Stripe-verified, 1 is Creem-verified and 1 is Polar-verified. And we have verification of each of those figures.

companies.name: Conductor
companies.description: The QuickBooks Desktop & Enterprise API — real-time access to every QBD object via Python, Node/TypeScript, and REST. Abstracts Web Connector, qbXML, SOAP, and the rest of Intuit's legacy mess.
companies.evidence: ~$40.5k MRR, 255 active subscriptions, ~$38.5k L30, ~$460k all-time, ~1,500 users claimed, founded Jul 2022, bootstrapped. Last sync Sep 30, 2026. Founder note on profile: ~$350k ARR, ~7% MoM, Ramp among enterprise customers, virtually no churn (company-stated on TrustMRR).
companies.indieAngle: Pick a painful legacy system (QBD, on-prem ERP, country e-invoicing) and sell the API glue forever.
companies.whyItPrints: Developers integrating with QBD still need a reliable bridge. Conductor sells $49/company-file/mo infrastructure that "completely runs itself" — classic Conductor-lane accounting glue, not another AI wrapper.

companies.name: Calendesk
companies.description: B2B booking + payments + client portal for therapists, psychologists, coaches, lawyers, beauty/fitness — white-label, subscription packages, API-first. Polish-founded, bootstrapped since 2020.
companies.evidence: ~$21.5k MRR, 376 active subscriptions, ~$37.0k L30, ~$1.13M all-time, founded May 2020, Poland. Last sync Sep 30, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Country/vertical booking for regulated service pros (therapy, legal, tutoring) still underserved vs Calendly-generic.
companies.whyItPrints: Service pros already schedule and take deposits every day. Calendesk owns that workflow at ~$79–$147/mo instead of inventing a new category.

companies.name: SoldComps
companies.description: eBay sold-comps API for resellers and analysts — one keyword returns up to 200 completed sales with real prices, conditions, and dates.
companies.evidence: ~$18.8k MRR, 488 active subscriptions, ~$18.8k L30, ~$38.1k all-time, founded Mar 2025, Canada. Last sync Sep 30, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Wrap a marketplace's awkward public data into a paid API — same shape as ControlResell ops, but for pricing intel.
companies.whyItPrints: Resellers live on sold comps. eBay's own APIs are restricted/messy; SoldComps sells clean access at $9–$79/mo. Pure data plumbing for a sweaty niche.

companies.name: MedPilot
companies.description: AI receptionist / patient-booking stack for medical practices — after-hours calls, no-show recovery, lead follow-up. Pricing starts ~$297–$2,497/mo (quote-based).
companies.evidence: ~$44.7k L30, ~$795k all-time, listed MRR ~$302 with 63 active subscriptions (L30 >> MRR — treat as mixed/usage billing, not pure seat SaaS). Founded Oct 2022, US. Last sync Sep 30, 2026. Listed domain medpilothq.com (homepage was unreachable from our fetch; image from TrustMRR landing screenshot).
companies.indieAngle: Vertical "answer the phone + book the calendar" for one regulated niche beats horizontal AI chat.
companies.whyItPrints: Clinics hate empty chairs and missed calls. High ACV practice software billed on Stripe; L30 revenue dwarfs listed subscription MRR (usage/setup-heavy mix).

companies.name: SEOBOT
companies.description: AI agent for SEO — keywords, research, blog, mini apps, pSEO — from John Rush's stable. ~$49/mo.
companies.evidence: ~$39.1k MRR, 538 active subscriptions, ~$39.8k L30, ~$1.88M all-time, ~200k users claimed, founded Sep 2023. Last sync Sep 30, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Autopilot content for a specific channel (SEO/AEO) with clear $49 packaging — productized agency energy without the retainer chaos.
companies.whyItPrints: Founders still buy "write and publish SEO content for me." Recurring content ops on Stripe with a long all-time trail. (Promoted from Sep 28 honorable mention with fresh sync.)

companies.name: Heron Copier
companies.description: Multi-platform trade copier + trading journal — copy between cTrader, MT4/MT5, TradeLocker, MatchTrader, DXtrade, Telegram; cloud or local, no VPS required.
companies.evidence: ~$8.3k MRR, 492 active subscriptions, ~$8.2k L30, ~$496k all-time, founded Jun 2023, Indonesia. Last sync Sep 30, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Own one painful workflow inside a trading stack (copy, journal, risk) and charge $19/mo forever.
companies.whyItPrints: Retail traders pay monthly for copy/journal tooling. Narrow fintech utility with hundreds of subs and nearly $500k lifetime — not a consumer social app.

companies.name: textbee
companies.description: Open-source Twilio alternative — turn an Android phone into an SMS gateway; send/receive programmatically with no per-message gateway fees. Free / Pro ~$9.99 / Scale ~$29.99.
companies.evidence: ~$3.6k MRR, 327 active subscriptions, ~$3.7k L30, ~$31.4k all-time, ~30k users claimed, founded Nov 2024, Ethiopia, bootstrapped. Last sync Sep 30, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Open-core + cheap pro tier for a commodity API (SMS, email, WhatsApp) that businesses already budget for.
companies.whyItPrints: SMS is still how ops tools notify humans. BYOD gateway undercuts Twilio for indie/dev use cases; Polar-verified recurring.

companies.name: QuoteDeck
companies.description: Insurance SaaS for agents/agencies to create and present professional life & health quotes (vs screenshots, messy PDFs, phone chase). Solo founder, bootstrapped. ~$60–$140/mo.
companies.evidence: ~$2.1k MRR, 11 active subscriptions, ~$1.2k L30, ~$17.5k all-time, team of 1, founded Nov 2025, US. Last sync Sep 30, 2026. (Listed for sale on TrustMRR marketplace recently.)
companies.indieAngle: Most solo-plausible vertical of the day — one licensed niche, quote → signature → compliance.
companies.whyItPrints: Insurance agents still sell with ugly PDFs. Vertical quoting + compliance workflow is pure niche ops SaaS.

companies.name: Easy Moving Permits
companies.description: Online platform to apply for and manage moving / street / dumpster / scaffolding parking permits across cities — transparent pricing including city fees + service charge; charged per application via Stripe.
companies.evidence: ~$2.0k L30, MRR $0 / no active subscriptions (transaction model), ~$24.4k all-time, founded Nov 2025, US. Last sync Sep 30, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Government-process UX for one city → expand city-by-city; service fee on top of municipal fees.
companies.whyItPrints: Civic permit glue. Movers and residents will pay to not get towed. Transaction model, not seats — same energy as MyCater's "take a cut of the inevitable spend."

companies.name: Expensent
companies.description: Finds receipts/invoices in Gmail/Outlook/IMAP and forwards them to your accountant, QuickBooks, Xero, Expensify, etc. — one-click catch-up + auto-forward rules. Solo, bootstrapped, Portugal. Solo ~$19/mo, Pro ~$59/mo.
companies.evidence: ~$845 MRR, ~$755 L30, ~$2.6k all-time, ~50 users claimed, team of 1, founded Dec 2025. Last sync Sep 30, 2026.
companies.indieAngle: Earliest-stage Conductor-shaped hit of the day — own the "get invoices to the books" wedge before building a full ledger.
companies.whyItPrints: Tiny today, but pure Conductor-cousin: inbox → bookkeeping glue. SMBs already hate digging receipts for their accountant.

honorableMentions.name: Shopquantum / BestFulfill
honorableMentions.note: Stripe-verified fulfillment/analytics ops, ~$2.12M all-time, MRR shown as none (transaction/ops model). L30 not clearly listed on profile title. Homepage had no og:image.

honorableMentions.name: AEO Engine
honorableMentions.note: Stripe-verified AI SEO agency, ~$128k MRR / ~$161k L30 / ~$2.46M all-time / 51 subs (was Sep 28 honorable; still printing).

honorableMentions.name: Scantrader
honorableMentions.note: Stripe-verified AI trading analysis ~$11.2k MRR / 289 subs / ~$16.8k L30; for sale on marketplace.

honorableMentions.name: Presscart
honorableMentions.note: media placement marketplace ~$62k L30 / ~$3.27M all-time; Stripe sync stale since Jul 17, 2026.

honorableMentions.name: Roofclaw
honorableMentions.note: preconfigured AI MacBooks for roofing ops; ~$1.86M all-time Stripe-verified (hardware + services hybrid).
